about: Written by surfaces.mjs from the game's source. Do not edit by hand. Each entry is one string a writer supplies, or one list of strings where `lines` gives the fewest and the most. `now` is the text the game shows today, with {braces} where the code puts a value in; `slots` lists those, and the new text carries each of them once. `empty` marks an entry that may be left as an empty string. `must` lists words the text has to contain. `planned` marks an entry for something plan.md adds and the game does not have yet. `needs` lists the internal keys the text is about.

eight.intro:b_colossus.now: Roots come up through the paving.

eight.intro:b_hart.now: Hoofbeats come up out of the dark.

eight.intro:b_luminarch.now: Crystal gathers over the stone and turns.

eight.intro:b_maw.now: The sand in the bowl begins to move.

eight.intro:b_regent.now: Something large circles over the kite.

eight.intro:b_sporemother.now: The smoke reaches the roof, and the roof moves.

eight.intro:b_warden.now: The bell is rung, and something pale comes up.

eight.line:dawn_down.note: plan C: the strongest of the deep kind goes back down at dawn

eight.line:fallen.sub.now: Check the guide for what this unlocks

eight.line:night_only.now: Kuranga comes up only at night.

eight.phase:b_colossus.1.now: Its roots tear up out of the paving.

eight.phase:b_hart.2.now: It charges, and is somewhere else.

eight.phase:b_luminarch.1.now: The crystals round it begin to turn.

eight.phase:b_luminarch.2.now: It stops holding its shape, and pieces come away.

eight.phase:b_maw.1.now: It stays up and thrashes, shedding grit.

eight.phase:b_regent.1.now: Pieces of it begin to fall on the floor.

eight.phase:b_sovereign.1.now: Stone grinds on stone. The stack parts, and its lit middle shows.

eight.phase:b_sovereign.2.now: It is coming apart, and everything in it shows.

eight.phase:b_sporemother.1.now: Its cap splits, and the inside glows.

eight.phase:b_sporemother.2.now: Its growth tears from the roof, and it swings.

eight.phase:b_warden.1.now: It turns, throwing pale matter in spirals.

eight.phase:b_warden.2.now: It is coming apart, and the smaller ones come for it.

folk.housed:apothecary.now: Put it on the table, away from the pot. | A salve now is worth ten after.

folk.housed:beastcaller.now: Things follow you if you ask correctly. | It stays for what is on the bone.

folk.housed:deserter.now: I marched with them. I will not again. | Mūda is a night inside the light at any fire of ours.

folk.housed:provisioner.now: Eat before you go under. The dark is hungry enough for both of you. | I buy anything. I sell most things.

folk.housed:runescribe.now: A staff is the same work as a hearthstone, pointed away from you. | The geodes sing if you hold them to your ear. Do not answer.

folk.housed:smith.now: Iron lifts with a stone pick, and Hīrak does not. | Bring me something worth hammering and I will stay.

folk.housed:tinker.now: Two good things, one better thing. That is the whole trade. | I had a Cloud Bottle once, and sold it.

folk.housed:wayfinder.now: They said every stone on this road was lit once. | A door, a light, a bed, four walls. That is all anyone asks. | When you are lost, open the Guide.

item.desc:ash_token.now: Glass from under a sand-country fire. A night inside the light at any of their fires.

item.desc:briar_bracer.now: +4 defense. Attackers take 40% of the damage they deal.

item.desc:cairn_key.now: Lay it on the Cairn. Nihān comes up through the base to take it.

item.desc:cloud_bottle.now: Grants a second jump in mid-air.

item.desc:eclipse_ember.now: A coal from the last eclipse. It has not gone out.

item.desc:eclipse_mask.now: Lay it on a Kuranga Altar at night. Kuranga comes up to it.

item.desc:effigy.now: A little carved thing that something answers to.

item.desc:gale_emblem.now: Second jump and no fall damage.

item.desc:heartroot.now: It still moves. On a bench it loosens two worked pieces far enough to join them.

item.desc:hollow_gate_kit.now: Raises a gate to the hollow where you place it.

item.desc:lucky_coin.now: Creatures drop 25% more coins and loot.

item.desc:lumenite.now: A clear gem from the deep rock. It gives a cold light.

item.desc:magnet_shell.now: Pulls dropped items from farther away.

item.desc:mana_crystal.now: Old lees, set hard. The head of every staff.

item.desc:pot_crystal.note: a single crystal in the shape of the inside of a jar: a store where the salt failed and nothing found the lees (6.11)

item.desc:prism_core.now: +16% crystal-work damage, +40 mana, faster mana regeneration.

item.desc:prism_heart.now: Splits light, heat and ore alike.

item.desc:prism_lens.now: Lay it on a Ratan Altar. Ratan comes to it.

item.desc:queen_spore.now: Feeds a kiln that burns without heat.

item.desc:recall_stone.now: Returns you to your bed. Reusable.

item.desc:rift_gate_kit.now: Raises a gate to the islands where you place it.

item.desc:scorched_core.now: Bedded in a ring of deep rock, it loosens Jalit ore.

item.desc:shadow_cloak.now: 10% chance to slip a hit entirely.

item.desc:skyrunner_treads.now: Speed, height, a second jump and a soft landing.

item.desc:soul_reliquary.now: +30 health, +50 mana and steady regeneration of both.

item.desc:sovereign_light.now: A piece of the housing with its gem in it. Everything, a little better.

item.desc:spore_censer.now: Lay it on a Guhamāt Altar. Guhamāt comes to the smoke.

item.desc:storm_kite.now: Fly it from a Jīmūt Altar. Jīmūt comes to it.

item.desc:storm_plume.now: Crackles. Points upward no matter how you hold it.

item.desc:sunken_lure.now: Lay it on a Maruhar Altar. Maruhar comes up to it.

item.desc:tempest_feather.now: +22% speed, +8% attack speed, no fall damage.

item.desc:verdant_idol.now: Lay it on a Vanahar Altar. Vanahar comes up to it.

item.desc:warden_bell.now: Lay it on a Kankāl Altar. Kankāl comes up to it.

item.desc:wardens_aegis.now: +8 defense and you barely budge when struck.

key:sprint.note: for R, Ctrl or double-tap W

menu:seed_field.now: Seed (leave blank for a random one)

menu:title.sub.now: a voxel sandbox of lost lights
menu:title.sub.note: the line under the title; no light is lost or won in this world (8.11)

task.how:aether.now: Blue ore in island rock. Tala Pick, Guhamāt Furnace.

task.how:anvil.now: Seven iron bars at the workbench. Metal gear is made on it.

task.how:bell.now: 2 iron bars, Hīrak, 2 shade flesh and 2 bone, at the anvil. Chests in a sealed store sometimes hold one.

task.how:bench.now: Press E. Turn a log into planks, then arrange four planks in a square.

task.how:boss1.now: Right-click the Vanahar Altar while holding the likeness. Bring food, salves and armour.

task.how:boss2.now: Use the lure at a Maruhar Altar. It strikes from below: keep moving when the sand ripples.

task.how:boss3.now: Ring the bell at a Kankāl Altar. Its orbs are slow: sidestep, do not back away.

task.how:boss4.now: Burn the smoker at a Guhamāt Altar in the hollow. Kill the Kavak before they pile up.

task.how:boss5.now: Fly the kite from a Jīmūt Altar on the living ground. Bring a bow or a staff: it rarely lands.

task.how:boss6.now: Set the lens on a Ratan Altar on the islands. Its beam turns slowly: run across it, not away.

task.how:boss7.now: Use the mask at a Kuranga Altar, at night. It will not come by day.

task.how:boss8.now: Everything you have. Everything you are.

task.how:censer.now: 2 Antar bars, 3 spore sacs and a glowing mushroom, at the anvil.

task.how:cinder.now: Smelt Jalit ore in the Maruhar Furnace and make a full set of armour for your style.

task.how:crucible.now: Ratan Remains ringed by island rock. It smelts Patik.

task.how:dim1.now: Step into the gate and hold still.

task.how:dim2.now: Step into the gate. Mind the edges: there is nothing under the islands.

task.how:eclforge.now: Kuranga Remains ringed by black glass. It smelts Gahan, deep in the living ground (y under 14).

task.how:eclipse.now: Patik Pick. The ore glows violet near bedrock.

task.how:emberforge.now: Maruhar Remains ringed by deep rock. It loosens Jalit ore, the glowing orange ore near lava.

task.how:furnace.now: Eight rubble in a ring at the workbench.

task.how:gate1.now: Black Glass is the black glass rimming lava pools near bedrock (y under 12). Hīrak Pick. Seven of it around Kankāl Remains at the anvil, then place the gate.

task.how:gate2.now: Six Tala bars around Jīmūt Remains, at the anvil.

task.how:house.now: Enclose a room with a door and a torch, then place a Holder's Bed (hide over planks). Someone will come.

task.how:idol.now: A log, 2 fiber, 2 jelly (from Kinva) and a red flower, at the workbench.

task.how:iron.now: Iron ore has tan flecks and needs a stone pick. Smelt it in the furnace with coal or wood.

task.how:ironpick.now: At the anvil. It can break gold, geodes and Hīrak.

task.how:key.now: 3 Gahan bars, a Hīrak Block, 2 moon slivers and 2 shards, at the anvil.

task.how:kite.now: 2 crystal fiber, 3 feathers, a Tala bar and moth dust, at the workbench.

task.how:lens.now: 2 Ākās bars, 3 shards (from Sakal) and glass, at the anvil.

task.how:lumenite.now: Cyan gems glowing in deep rock, far below sea level (y under 34). Iron pick or better.

task.how:lumpick.now: At the anvil. It bites Jalit ore and black glass.

task.how:lure.now: 2 sandstone, a gold bar, raw meat and ember dust (Angār haunt dunes at night and lava caves).

task.how:mask.now: 2 Patik bars, 3 moon slivers and 2 shade flesh, at the Line Frame.

task.how:noctrium.now: Mine Tala with an Antar Pick and smelt it in the Guhamāt Furnace.

task.how:prism.now: Pink ore on the islands. Ākās Pick, Ratan Furnace.

task.how:slivers.now: Every eighth night the moon turns. Chandasāvak and Ulūk drop Moon Slivers: you need 3.

task.how:stonepick.now: Dig down to stone, then craft a stone pick at the workbench.

task.how:tinker.now: Vanahar Remains between two iron bars, over planks. It joins two trinkets into one.

task.how:torch.now: Coal over a stick makes torches. Coal shows as black flecks in stone. Shades walk at night.

task.how:umbrite.now: Violet ore in hollow rock. Jalit Pick required. The Maruhar Furnace will smelt it.

task.how:voidkiln.now: Guhamāt Remains ringed by hollow rock. It smelts Tala, the teal ore of the hollow.

task.how:wood.now: Hold left-click on a tree trunk to break it. Collect 4 logs.

task.how:woodpick.now: Place the workbench and right-click it. Three planks over two sticks. The recipe book fills the grid for you.
